input.question: 94 Squadron was formed in which year?

documents.text: No. 94 Squadron RAF No. 94 Squadron RAF was a unit of the Royal Air Force that served during World War I & World War II. The squadron has been formed a total of four times. The squadron was formed at Harling Road on 1 August 1917, as a training unit for the Sopwith Camel. Mobilised in May 1918, the Squadron moved to France at the end of October with S.E.5A's but due to the end of the war being imminent, the squadron returned to the UK, without seeing any action, in February 1919 disbanding on 30 June 1919. source_segments.text: 94 Squadron RAF was a unit of the Royal Air Force that served during World War I & World War II.
The squadron has been formed a total of four times.
The squadron was formed at Harling Road on 1 August 1917, as a training unit for the Sopwith Camel.

Mobilised in May 1918, the Squadron moved to France at the end of October with S.E.5A's but due to the end of the war being imminent, the squadron returned to the UK, without seeing any action, in February 1919 disbanding on 30 June 1919.
